claim_boundary: The active system is the current task-chat model executing the repository architecture and procedures, but no architecture, hourly model choice, CI/reference result, bounded learning campaign, trial-ledger result, internal regression decision, self-produced artifact, blocker reconciliation, or unsigned/unverified independence assertion counts as verified AGI. A verified claim requires the conservative external production evidence gate to pass on genuinely independent auditable evidence with no unresolved failures or contamination.
